notes: LAUNCH-CRITICAL CHECK CONFIRMED (Scenario 16, Q11b bounded-max platform test): the checkbox UI allowed selecting all 6 options simultaneously — the 5 real symptom checkboxes AND 'None of these' together — with no client-side mutual-exclusion enforced (verified via screenshot showing all 6 checked before advancing). Despite this, the resulting Workflow Opportunity score (87%) matches the manifest's expected value exactly, confirming the scoring engine correctly ignores the zero-point 'None of these' selection when real symptoms are also present, rather than averaging it in or zeroing out the score. This is an important platform-robustness confirmation: a confused or careless respondent who selects contradictory options still gets an accurate score based on the real signal. Scores match manifest exactly (Readiness 54%, Workflow Opportunity 87%). Ran solo, single tab, fresh /questions navigation.
